articles.title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
articles.snippet: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

articles.title: BNY in talks with Kraken parent Payward over infrastructure partnership
articles.snippet: The potential agreement could span digital assets, custody, trading, payments and other financial-market infrastructure.

articles.title: Once a $2 billion Ethereum layer-2, Blast is shutting down after assets plunge 98%
articles.snippet: Once home to more than $2 billion in crypto assets, Blast is shutting down as activity fades, costs rise, and bigger platforms like Coinbase and Robinhood build networks of their own.

articles.title: Trump’s potential AI czar, Jay Clayton, helped pioneer the SEC’s crypto crackdown
articles.snippet: The former SEC chairman who may be tapped to oversee the Trump administration's AI work has a potentially divisive history as a watchdog of tech innovation.

articles.title: America at a crossroads: Commissioner Peirce’s parting challenge
articles.snippet: It is incumbent upon us to continue Commissioner Peirce’s mission, writes Will Schwartz, policy associate at the Blockchain Association.
